DIAGNOSIS READY: Aneurysmal Bone Cyst of the distal femur.

The "soap bubble" appearance on the X-ray, combined with the lytic lesion and lack of systemic infectious signs, strongly points to a benign but locally aggressive bone tumor. Given your young age and the specific imaging characteristics, this is the most likely cause of your night pain and swelling.
